scripts.typeorm: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js
scripts.migration:run: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js migration:run -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:revert: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js migration:revert -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:show: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js migration:show -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.migration:generate: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/typeorm/cli-ts-node-commonjs.js migration:generate -d src/data-source.ts
scripts.dc:migrate: docker-compose -f ../docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm backend npm run migration:run
scripts.dc:test:cov: docker-compose -f ../docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm backend npm run test:cov -- --runInBand
scripts.demo:full: cross-env TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY=true node -r ts-node/register -r tsconfig-paths/register scripts/demo-full-flow.ts
